## Responsibility

This module long-polls the orders queue and, on `OrderPlaced`, publishes an
order-confirmation email. It also sends SMS receipts through Twilio for
every order.

## Entry points and interfaces

- `NotificationsWorker.run_once()` — polls `orders.order_placed` and sends
  the resulting confirmation email.

## Dependencies and consumers

- Producer: `orders` (`source/orders/order_service.py`) publishes
  `OrderPlacedEvent` to the shared queue.
- Consumer: this worker, and nothing else.
